These public-page excerpts were fetched on 11 October 2026 using Node HTTP or
Chromium, then stripped of scripts, style, form inputs and embedded media.
They preserve the site's actual HTML structure and English/Kannada wording.
They are parser regression fixtures, not a current production data feed.

Source URLs are in `src/pipeline/sources.js`. Files correspond to UP, Karnataka,
Bihar, INSPIRE, AICTE, ONGC, Reliance UG/PG and LIC. `wb.json` is the actual public
government myScheme response for slug `svmcms`. No application credentials,
student documents or personal profile data are included.
